lines.text: The cries of the earth did ring in mine ears today, their origin the Orbital Spire if my senses deceive me not. For such an uproar to come thence, in this world so full of Raptures, doth import but one thing; there is a change upon the Raptures.
... This portends naught but ill. My mind thus whispers me: I needs must see it with mine own eyes. I shall make for the Orbital Spire.
I leave this record for fear my NIMPH should take corruption. May that this report never be heard save from my NIMPH.
